svg.title: Discord server logo: a robot, a tank and a single-rotor gunship on a hex grid map, transparent background
svg.desc: A square image with no background fill. A tilted hexagonal tile map in teal, green and slate spans the width. A blue cartoon robot stands on a highlighted tile at the far left, a coral cartoon tank sits on a highlighted tile at the far right with its barrel aimed inward, and a purple single-rotor gunship hovers over its own highlighted tile at the top center, casting a shadow on the tile below.
